import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[9]
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    base = params[0] + params[1]*v + params[2]*v*v + params[3]*v**3
    h1 = params[4]*c + params[5]*s + params[6]*v*c + params[7]*v*s + params[8]*v*v*c
